digest.component_or_area: LLM capabilities override table (Bedrock & Anthropic adapters)
propositions: The _MODEL_ID_CAPABILITY_OVERRIDES table is missing entries for claude-opus-4-8 (rebar's DEFAULT_MODEL) and both global.* and us.* Bedrock profile prefixes of the opus line, leaving the default model unguarded against temperature deprecation 400 errors.

Temperature parameter is deprecated (rejected with ValidationException) on claude-opus-4-8 and claude-opus-4-7 across both us.anthropic and global.anthropic prefixes; temp=1.0 succeeds but temp=0.0 and temp=0.5 fail, indicating rejection of non-default sampling tunability rather than complete parameter removal.

Code-review Pass-2 pins temperature=0 for determinism but runs on claude-opus-4-8 without the capability guard, causing silent resampling in production because pydantic-ai's Anthropic adapter drops the parameter at models/anthropic.py:641 without wire visibility.

The top_p parameter is also deprecated on the same opus models (confirmed by CloudTrail) but has no supports_top_p capability record, creating a latent defect that becomes live when rebar configures top_p sampling.

Both Bedrock adapter (hard 400 failure) and Anthropic adapter (silent drop + warning) exhibit the defect via the same root cause: incomplete override table keyed on bare id and profile-prefixed variants.
